Rivian R2 Review – Perfect for Daily Driving & Everyday Adventures
I spent a full day behind the wheel of the Rivian R2, the company's latest electric SUV offering, now meant for the masses, ranging from about $45k to $60k depending on the trim chosen (standard, premium, and sport). All trims, minus Standard RWD, are capable of over 300 miles of range (275 mi for S-RWD), ranging from 307 to 345 miles depending on the option selected. In this video, we'll cover many aspects of the Rivian R2, to determine if it's the right vehicle for you, including:
1) The basics (price, range, power)
